0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with the Suns making the trip to Portland. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), and Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (hip soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery) and has Chris Youngblood (calf soreness), Jrue Holiday (hand soreness), and Micah Potter (illness) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The Suns won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but they lost 92-77 in Phoenix to Portland in their most recent meeting on February 22, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Phoenix a 40% chance to win.
